description: Three cascading squares in a specified stacking order. Any other order produces a visibly different figure.
prompt: On a 200x200 pixel canvas filled with white (#ffffff), draw three filled 90x90 pixel squares, each one on top of the previous: first a red (#ff0000) square with its top-left corner at (20, 20), then a green (#00ff00) square with its top-left corner at (55, 55), then a blue (#0000ff) square with its top-left corner at (90, 90). Coordinates are in pixels measured from the top-left corner of the canvas, with x increasing to the right and y increasing downwards.
